title: Button
description: Black leads; lines and ghosts support. Hover, disabled and loading states included.
usage: One primary action per view. Use Secondary for the alternative, Ghost for tertiary actions, Danger only for destructive ones.
a11y: Native buttons with explicit types, a token-based focus-visible ring, and hover/active/disabled states for every variant. Loading examples use disabled and aria-busy while retaining their text label; decorative spinners stop under reduced motion. btn-asagi remains a deprecated alias of btn-accent.
